purpose: Fixed IK-directed physical grasp approaches; not RL, reset-asset or deployment acceptance
limitations: Distal mesh-cap proxies are not calibrated fleshy contact points.
Fixed initial-pose IK does not track the freely moving object during approach.
Opposed loaded contacts plus stationary hold do not establish force closure or disturbance robustness.
All four resets are development cases, with no independent randomization or real-robot validation.
The force ceilings are diagnostic design choices, not hardware safety guarantees.

mac_replica.kind: Independent same-seed ordinary resets, IK fits and physical approaches; not additional independent samples

decision: No stable loaded pinch or training/reset asset produced. Existing formal two-stage policy remains 7/100, unchanged.
next_bounded_hypothesis: Map thumb/index and thumb/middle shared workspace with explicit tip residual and collision checks; compare physical placement/pre-grasp candidates with separately versioned reset semantics before any RL.
additional_limitations: Optimizer convergence is not task-space target attainment.
One-start soft-constraint IK cannot prove global reachability or impossibility.
Observed contact-body unions are based on 20Hz solved-force samples, not continuous contact-force measurement.
This failure does not establish that all successful palm-supported rotations require distal pinching.
